name: Dragon, Ladon
body:
Ladon dragon
CR 24

A hundred heads on a hundred necks rise from the immense body of this hydra-like dragon. Its scales have the color of wood, but the shine and hardness of bronze.

Its many mouths open deafening you with the madness of multiple arguing voices.

XP 1,228,800
N Colossal dragon
Init +2; Senses all-round vision, dragon senses, true seeing; Perception +50
Aura frightful presence (360 ft., DC 34)

DEFENSE

AC 42, touch 0, flat-footed 42 (-2 Dex, +42 natural, -8 size)
Hp 521 (34d12+300); regeneration 10 (epic)
Fort +29, Ref +17, Will +28
DR 20/epic and magic; Immune mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, sonic; SR 35

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee bite +42 (4d8+24/19-20 plus vortex of a hundred bites), 2 claws +42 (4d6+16/19-20), tail slap +40 (4d6+24/19-20)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 20 ft. (30 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks mayhem choir, poison breath (70 ft. cone, DC 37)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th, concentration +27)

Constant—true seeing
At will—banshee blast (DC 23), foresight, greater dispel magic, pessimism (DC 22), vision
1/day—mage’s disjunction, summon (level 9, 1 pleiad or 2-5 hesperides, 100%)

STATISTICS

Str 42, Dex 6, Con 30, Int 24, Wis 28, Cha 24
Base Atk +34; CMB +58; CMD 64 (68 vs. trip)
Feats Alertness, Cleave, Cleaving Finish, Critical Focus, Great Cleave, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Cleaving Finish, Improved Critical (bite, claw, tail), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Staggering Critical, Vital Strike
Skills Appraise +44, Bluff +44, Climb +53, Diplomacy +44, Intimidate +44, Knowledge (arcana, history, geography, religion) +44, Linguistics +44, Perception +50, Sense Motive +50, Spellcraft +44
Languages Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Sylvan, plus any 30 others
SQ change shape (Medium constrictor snake or Large tree; beast shape I or tree shape), hydra traits, regenerate head, vision of madness

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Hydra Traits (Ex)

A ladon can be killed by severing all of its heads or slaying its body. Any attack that is not an attempt to sever a head affects the body, including area attacks or attacks that cause piercing or bludgeoning damage. To sever a head, an opponent must make a sunder attempt with a slashing weapon targeting a head. A head is considered a separate weapon with hardness 0 and 34 hit points. To sever a head, an opponent must inflict enough damage to reduce the head’s hit points to 0 or less. Severing a head deals 34 points of damage to Ladon’s body. Ladon can’t attack with a severed head, but takes no other penalties.

Mayhem Choir (Su)

A ladon can talk all at once from many of its heads even while other heads are attacking, giving different bits of information, chattering, or babble with each one. An opponent who tries to make sense of the dragon’s dozens of voices can momentarily lose their sanity. Each round that it uses mayhem choir, all opponents within 40 feet are affected as confusion (DC 34 Will negates). Once a creature has been affected by this ability, it is then immune to it for 24 hours. The saving throw is Charisma-based.

Poison Breath (Ex)

A ladon can use its breath weapon every 1d4 rounds through any one of its heads, but will emit it through only one head at a time. Creatures within the cone take 2d6 points of Constitution damage (Fortitude save to half damage). A ladon’s poison breath bypasses any immunity or resistance to poison that a target can have. A creature that succeeds at its saving throw against it’s poison breath is immune to further poison breath attacks for 24 hours. The saving throw is Constitution-based.

Regenerate Head (Ex)

When one of a ladon’s heads is destroyed, it regrows in 1d4 rounds. To prevent a new head from growing, at least 5 points of acid or fire damage must be dealt to the stump (a touch attack to hit) before they appear. Acid or fire damage from area attacks can affect stumps and the body simultaneously. A ladon doesn’t die from losing its heads until all are cut off and the stumps seared by acid or fire.

Regeneration (Ex)

A ladon’s regeneration applies only to damage inflicted on its body.

Vision of Madness (Su)

Some of a ladon’s heads could actually speak valuable advice or the one piece of information that someone was searching for. If a creature doesn’t fall victim of Ladon’s mayhem choir ability, it has a 10% chance to be granted a vision, as per the spell. This chance is cumulative for every subsequent Will save against mayhem choir that the creature succeeded at. The vision will have effect the next time the creature sleeps after the combat against Ladon ends.

Vortex of a Hundred Bites (Ex)

Ladon can bite with each one of its hundred heads in a round, but you don’t have to resolve each of these as a separate attack. Instead, Ladon rolls for one bite attack normally and hits every creature in its reach if its attack roll exceeds that creature’s AC. If the attack roll results in a possible critical hit, the critical is applied to one creature of Ladon’s choosing.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Ladon dragons are immense dragon-hydras. Even the gods fear a ladon’s strength and poisonous breath. Ladon dragons are vicious and cunning, often transforming into a snake or even a tree in the same garden it guards, in order to fool unwary intruders. It is nonetheless sometimes amused by temerarious creatures and can accept to engage in a battle of wits before finishing its victims. The great dragon has sometimes also been described as a tempter, selling bits of its great knowledge in exchange for morally gray favors or encouraging mortals to question their gods’ ways.

Ladon dragons treat hesperides and pleiades with haughtiness and condescension, expecting care and veneration by them and treating them in turn as its favorite pets.
